title: UX-01 task 7: the crowded-match reference, Flat tier
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Implementation-plan task 7 (standard §19–§21, design screen 1): MatchLayout (chrome, battlefield, decision column and player strip; stacked below 64 rem; whole viewport), MatchChrome, PlayerSummary (neutral initials and a turn marker in text), Counter (format thresholds, printed symbols with text labels), ZoneCount (openable public zones), TurnContext, Battlefield (Flat tier and semantic board: named sides and zones in one wrapping row each), BoardCard (state as text markers as well as rotation; selection and valid targets as outline rings with text), ActionPanel and ActionChoice (decision with prompt at the critical size, choices with reasons when unavailable), HandFan (non-overlapping 52 px hit slices, raise preview that moves only the image, arrow-key navigation), HandList and EventLog. Tokens for board, hand and match sizes, with compact board cards below 80 rem; 19 component strings; the style gate allows --hand-offset, set inline by HandFan.

stories/support/reference/match.ts authors turn 7 between the reference decks with every state traceable to a real card or rule; commands.ts derives actions, challenge targets (Evasive, ready), song payments (ink, ink drop, singers with reasons) and questers from the position and rules text. Match.stories.tsx runs the local command machine (select, action, targets, payment, required choose-one with a Ward-aware target, bulk-quest and end-turn reviews, pending, fixture-receipt acceptance, rejection, reconnect reconciliation, Escape stepping back only before submission), the match menu (confirmation settings, fan-content notice, concede review), discard lists, the tablet log sheet and portrait inspection sheet; stories cover the design's states plus hand as list and an empty side.

Reference fixture: six selection reasons corrected to the final position (Lafayette – All Ears has Alert, not Evasive; Chief Bogo, Mr. Big, Judy Hopps, Hiro Hamada and Baymax roles updated); the fixture is rebuilt from the same snapshot with no image change.
Eight crowded-match browser tests. RUN-20261022-029 passes the fixture tests and catalog:verify; RUN-20261022-030 passes the gates and 393/393 Chromium tests.

Visual review at 1440 x 900, 1180 x 820 and 820 x 1180 found an overflowing items row and hand strip, two-row sides on tablet landscape hiding markers, the fan rotating over the view switch, and a turn marker that read the same for both players; all fixed before the receipts. Captures are in the ignored .local/ux-01-review/.
Design-system runbook (crowded match) and validation (task 7); card-catalog validation correction note; handoff.
